_what: Reconciliation between a SEMANTIC treatment and a provider's POSITIONAL printing slot, per (set, number). Data, not a rule -- there is no rule; the ordering is whatever apitcg happened to do, and the only reason we can speak about it at all is that Limitless's asset URL carries the same suffix.
_refusal_is_the_default: An absent entry means `we have not established this`, never `slot 1`. Ordering the slots and calling the first one the base is the inference that made OP01-120 look like it needed re-homing.
_ground_truth_keeps_semantic_tokens: `manga_rare`, never `_p4`. A positional token would make the identity scheme catalog-derived, which is what the labelled set exists to avoid.

_slot_vocabulary_is_evidenced_not_assume.claim: Limitless's `?v=N` and apitcg's `_pN` are the same slot vocabulary.
_slot_vocabulary_is_evidenced_not_assume.confidence: n=1. CONFIRMED FOR EXACTLY ONE PAIRING -- `?v=2` serving `OP01-120_p2_EN.webp` -- plus base/no-suffix. One pairing is one observation of the mapping, not the mapping.
_slot_vocabulary_is_evidenced_not_assume.evidence: The asset URL carries the suffix, so the binding is observed rather than inferred from the order two sources happen to list printings in.
_slot_vocabulary_is_evidenced_not_assume.how_it_is_used: The adapter RE-CONFIRMS the binding per card from the image filename (`slot_binding_evidence`) rather than assuming it, and every run reports confirmations and contradictions. A card where it fails is evidence ABOUT THE MAPPING, not about that card.
_slot_vocabulary_is_evidenced_not_assume.not_claimed: That an image filename with NO `_pN` means the base printing. That is a convention we hold about apitcg's naming; `image_slot` reports such a page as slot None with the filename attached.

_disagreements.status: OPEN -- recorded, deliberately not reconciled. The fetch that would settle it has been attempted and did not land.

manifest.label: Prize Cards serial
manifest.product: UNKNOWN -- Championship 2023 Prize Cards serial per the print-table label, but no page has attested a product slug for it. The `?v=3` fetch returned the `?v=2` page and was refused.

limitless_says.observed: 2026-08-25, live fetch of the print table

this_project_previously_believed.derived_from: apitcg's grouping of image filename suffixes

_disagreements.the_disagreement: apitcg's grouping puts _p3 in prb01; Limitless's print table puts slot 3 in a Prize Cards product that this project did not know existed. The two also disagree on the count -- Limitless lists five printings, the apitcg-derived model assumed six.
_disagreements.not_reconciled_because: Both readings cannot be right and neither is checkable from here. Averaging them, or quietly preferring the newer one, would produce a number that no source states. The disagreement is the finding; it is recorded until a source can settle it.
_disagreements.what_would_settle_it: The `?v=3` page's own product link. ATTEMPTED 2026-08-25 and it did not arrive -- the request returned the `?v=2` page. The runner may get further; if it also lands on `?v=2`, THAT IS THE FINDING, and it will be reported as a slot mismatch rather than as an absent product.

_the_response_is_not_assumed_to_be_the_r.observed: 2026-08-25 -- a request for `?v=3` on OP01-120 returned the `?v=2` page: image `_p2`, body `Romance Dawn (OP01) Manga Art`, and `Romance Dawn manga` unlinked in the print table.
_the_response_is_not_assumed_to_be_the_r.cause: Unknown, and it does not matter. A site redirect and de-duping in the fetch path are indistinguishable from outside, and the guard is the same either way.
_the_response_is_not_assumed_to_be_the_r.guard: `verify_slot` parses the slot FROM THE PAGE and compares it to what was requested; a mismatch is recorded as unresolved and never credited to the slot that was asked for. A fetch that silently returns a neighbour is exactly how a wrong pair enters this table with everything green.
signals: The gap in the `?v=` run. Every row but the current printing carries a link, so on `?v=2` the links run 1, 3, 4 and the missing integer names the page. Assumes nothing about markup. ABSTAINS on a complete run, which is equally the base page and the `?v=N+1` page.
The image filename suffix (`_pN`, absent for base).
The page's own canonical `?v=`. Weakest -- the tag's presence is assumed rather than observed.
_the_response_is_not_assumed_to_be_the_r.signals_are_compared_never_merged: Where two speak and disagree the answer is None with the disagreement attached. A page that cannot say which printing it is must not be recorded as any printing.
